Classic Solitaire with a Bloody Twist

Stack villager cards in order to collect them to their safe spots. Beware, however, as a secret is hiding among them.

The Vampire will transform poor villagers into vampires, trying to block their escape routes. Do not fret, though! The Priest is here to heal vampires and transform them into villagers.

Adapt your strategy, find the balance and master the endless dance between Fangs & Faith!
